# Third-party files (unchanged copies)

- `tesseract/` — Tesseract.js 7.0.0 (Apache-2.0) and tesseract.js-core (Apache-2.0): reads printed text in photos, entirely in the browser.
- `tesseract/lang/eng.traineddata.gz` — English model from @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0 (4.0.0_best_int).
- `qrcode.js` — qrcode-generator 2.0.4 by Kazuhiko Arase (MIT): draws the QR codes.
